name: myco
description: Agent teams for Claude Code, packaged as installable plugins.

plugins.name: engineering-team
plugins.description: An agent team for engineering delivery: tech lead, ICs, independent code review, QA validation with a persistent test library, and a process analyst that proposes improvements to the team's own definitions.

plugins.name: design-team
plugins.description: Takes an idea to a decided design package — PRD, architecture, security review, tech design, and UX — ready to hand to an engineering team. A product lead owns the conversation and the decision loop; specialists write their documents and return questions to it.
